svg.title: Уголок на полу — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Exactly one full-body three-quarter side view of a strict FLOOR L-sit hold. Both open palms lie flat DIRECTLY ON the flat floor at each hip, fingers pointed forward, elbows locked straight, shoulders down. Hips visibly float slightly above the floor with no seat or other support. Both legs straight, together and horizontal forward at hip height, knees fully extended and both heels floating. Thin short ground baseline under palms only to establish contact. Do NOT draw any bars, stools, parallettes or a second figure. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
